Question:
The two bases of a prism are:

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h105_q4_question_en.svg)

Choices.B: Parallel to each other and congruent

Solution: The lateral edges of a prism connect two congruent, parallel bases. The lateral edges of a right prism are also perpendicular to the bases.
